objective: Prove a uniform lower bound for adaptive XOR trees with one arbitrary XOR of local products on each side, or exhibit a polynomial counterstrategy.
status: Proved: Arbitrary separate extra product XORs leave optimal case count of order two to one quarter of the number of path products. Allowing more XORs gives a polynomial case bound exactly at the order of m/log m bits on each side when their choices can be optimized. For 31 products each rank-seven component in a sub-512 candidate must split off independently from the total.
title: Test all pairs of fixed local XOR masks on growing paths
